system: Haspin (Q8TF76) with a kinase substrate; enzyme construct, source, and substrate identity are unresolved
readout: ADP-Glo luminescence measuring ADP generated by kinase activity

steps.instruction: Prepare a 10-point, threefold dilution series of CHEMBL4278808, including vehicle-only and no-compound controls. Use the same final vehicle fraction in every reaction.

parameters.top_concentration_uM: 10 uM; provisional assay-design assumption, not a measured property of CHEMBL4278808
parameters.vehicle_fraction: unresolved; select a constant, kinase-compatible final fraction and include matched vehicle controls

steps.instruction: Combine compound or control, haspin, substrate, and ATP, then run the kinase reaction. Include a no-enzyme background reaction and, if available, a validated haspin reference-inhibitor control.

parameters.enzyme_concentration: unresolved; requires a linear-range activity pilot
parameters.substrate_concentration: unresolved; substrate identity and concentration require optimization
parameters.ATP_concentration: unresolved; requires optimization and should be reported when interpreting potency
parameters.reaction_time: unresolved; choose a time within the linear product-formation range

steps.instruction: Stop the reaction and deplete residual ATP with ADP-Glo reagent, then perform the ADP detection reaction and record luminescence.

parameters.reagent_volumes: unresolved; use a supported ADP-Glo procedure matched to the reaction volume

steps.instruction: Subtract background, normalize vehicle activity to 100% and an appropriate fully inhibited/background condition to 0%, and fit concentration-response data. Report the estimated IC50 with confidence intervals, replicate variability, curve diagnostics, and any concentrations affected by solubility or interference.

parameters.fit_model: Four-parameter logistic model as a provisional assumption; constrain or fix asymptotes only when justified by controls and curve coverage
parameters.acceptance_criteria: unresolved numerical thresholds; prespecify acceptable control variability, signal window, replicate agreement, and curve-fit quality before testing

controls: Vehicle-only control matched to the final compound vehicle fraction
Validated haspin reference-inhibitor control if available; identity and concentration unresolved
rationale: The selected cards directly measure biochemical inhibition of haspin rather than cellular viability. The retained examples show that other compounds have inhibited haspin in biochemical assays, with reported IC50 values from 34 to 770 nM, but they are not similarity-ranked and do not establish potency for CHEMBL4278808. The proposed 10 uM top concentration and ten threefold dilutions are explicitly provisional assumptions that provide a broad range extending to approximately 0.51 nM, covering the contextual example range without predicting the query IC50. Three replicates are a provisional precision assessment. Reaction linearity, ATP and substrate conditions, and detection timing must be established before interpreting the fitted value.
limitations: No direct potency measurement for CHEMBL4278808 is supplied; the retained IC50 values are contextual evidence for other compounds only.
The concentration-series values and replicate count are provisional design assumptions, not sourced assay conditions.
Enzyme construct and origin, substrate identity, ATP concentration, reaction conditions, vehicle tolerance, and ADP-Glo volumes and incubation times remain unresolved.
Compound solubility, aggregation, luminescence interference, and ATP-depletion or detection interference require controls or orthogonal confirmation if suspected.
A biochemical IC50 demonstrates inhibition in this assay but does not by itself establish cellular efficacy or target-specific causality; cell-viability cards were therefore not included.
